# Price-audit evidence fixtures (2026-08-31)

These files support `docs/price-audit-2026-08-31.md`. They are audit evidence,
not production fixtures and not desired-behaviour contracts.

Evidence classes:

- `static-probes.json`: deterministic current-code behaviour, generated by
  `scripts/price_audit/static_probes.py` without network access.
- `catalog-probes.txt`: read-only SQL snapshot of 4,901 dev listings.
- `redis/report-*.json`: exact semantic payloads captured from Redis DB 2 and
  pretty-printed without changing JSON values.
- `redis/photo-cache.json`: hashed photo-cache keys, verdicts and capture TTLs.
- `redis/analysis.json`: offline recomputation; cached data is post-gate and all
  frequencies are lower bounds.
- `serper-*.json`: raw Serper responses. No API key is stored.
- `page-*.json`: complete HTTP response bodies encoded as deterministic
  `gzip+base64`; `page-analysis.json` verifies the stored SHA-256 digests.
- `llm-replay-*.json` and `b1-live-candidate-llm-3x.json`: paid frozen-input
  outputs. Replaying them incurs new API cost and is unnecessary for offline QA.

`audit-metadata.json` is the budget/provenance ledger. No fixture contains API,
database or Redis credentials. Capture helpers enforce absolute ceilings of 30
Serper queries, 60 LLM calls and 100 page fetches even if a larger CLI limit is
requested.

`MANIFEST.sha256` covers the verdict, scripts and all evidence files except the
manifest itself, so later drift can be detected offline.
